attributes.proposal_description:
You can check out the proposal on this google doc for a better layout: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AKKNezENVTFy92JaECEYz1BSs2gWQzSg4gxBIcbRhiA/edit?usp=sharing

Please check out this short explanatory video: https://youtu.be/DOHuqfIKbY8

Cardano dApps need support with leads for clients and investors. Obtaining targeted business leads is very costly and time-consuming.
Our goal is to generate business leads to companies through a trusted network, help companies grow and support mass adoption. As a pilot, this proposal will generate business leads for several Cardano companies. 

Success =
	•	200 qualified leads delivered to 20+ Cardano companies
	•	20+ trained lead generators active
	•	10+ ecosystem partners using LeadGenDAO services
	•	Increased ecosystem funding or customer engagement reported by partners


“The Cardano ecosystem needs strong sales and business development activities and reach for investors and clients” was the common feedback from numerous companies in the Cardano ecosystem, including CF and Emurgo.

The Cardano ecosystem is rich in innovation but lacks the business development engine that can bridge products to markets. By creating a decentralized network of incentivized lead generators, we can accelerate adoption and revenue generation for on-chain projects.

Without go-to-market and investor traction, Cardano dApps remain underutilized. LeadGenDAO brings a decentralized, scalable solution—empowering the community to fuel project growth.

LeadGenDAO enables a decentralized business development layer for Cardano by training and compensating community-based lead generators who deliver qualified leads to ecosystem projects.

Using Andamio, LeadGenDAO aims to evolve into a fully decentralized organization where lead generators and participating companies govern rewards distribution, onboarding, and platform evolution through on-chain voting and treasury proposals.

Benefits to Cardano:
- Supports ecosystem project growth and sustainability
- Drives real-world use cases and adoption
- Engages the community in value creation (anyone can be a lead generator)
- Reduces reliance on centralized marketing or expensive conferences
- Helps investors find vetted, promising projects


The Lead Generation solution:
The lead generation model aims to support companies in the Cardano ecosystem by creating a pipeline of leads for clients, partners, and investors. The leads will be generated by a trusted network of community members who are great connectors and networkers. 
 Lead generators will be compensated for successful leads. Every lead must meet company-specific criteria and is reviewed and validated before compensation is released.

Our project is already live, and the lead generation course is available on the Andamio platform. We are currently onboarding lead generators and having our first leads generated, for 4 Cardano companies: NMKR, Socious, Palmyra, and Andamio. 
Our goal with this funding request is to have 20+ lead generators, generating over 200 leads for 20+ Cardano companies.

The lead generator process: 
- Lead Generator completes onboarding via Andamio
- Generator identifies a potential lead
- Lead is submitted through platform
- Reviewed and approved by client company
- The lead generator organizes a call between the company and the lead
- The lead generator is compensated with 400-500 ADA for generating the lead (if the value of ADA changes we will change the price per lead, we want to make sure that they are compensated between $300 and $500 per lead)

After that, the company can choose to keep the lead generator as a moderator and that would keep participating in the collaboration
The generator would receive more compensation according to what is decided with the company

Current Status
- website live www.leadgendao.com 
- Pilot stage live with 5 leads approved for 4 Cardano companies
- 10 lead generators expected by the end of April
- Info courses available on Andamio for lead gen
- We already have the courses of 4 companies ready on the platform, here is the link of the full course: https://app.andamio.io/course/blg2024
- Companies courses: NMKR, Socious, Palmyra, Andamio
- There are already other companies in the ecosystem interested in our service



Andamio platform is now live on mainnet and is constantly improving
Here are all the courses currently available on the platform : https://app.andamio.io/course

Lead Examples: NMKR
We are going to share here the type of leads that NMKR expect with the LeadGen project, as well as an approved lead by NMKR:

NMKR lead needs: 
Company size: Mid-sized to large companies
Investment budget: $10k to $50k in the short term to implement blockchain technology into their operations
Geographic focus: Europe, Japan, South Korea, India, North and South America
Interest areas: 
- Sustainability
- Decentralization of wealth
- Tokenization of real-world assets (i.e. real-estate)

Important note: leads should have a clear and immediate business use case for blockchain, such as enhancing business processes or creating tailored NFTs / Token or blockchain solutions.

Example industries and use cases: 
- Decentralization of wealth: A fintech startup aiming to democratize access to investment vehicles through blockchain.
- Sustainability: A mid-sized energy company looking to create NFT-based carbon credits to incentivize renewable energy consumption.
- Real-estate: A property developer exploring tokenized fractional ownership of real estate assets to open up new investment opportunities. 

Key Pain Points and Needs
- Brands are increasingly interested in leveraging NFTs to engage with customers, but many marketing agencies lack the in-house expertise to implement effective NFT strategies.
- Agencies need a reliable and user-friendly NFT platform that seamlessly integrates with their existing marketing and content creation workflows.
- Guidance and support are needed to navigate the NFT space's technical and regulatory aspects and best practices for successful NFT-based campaigns.

Feedback Summary on Proposal: Business Lead Generation on Cardano

1. What stands out?
The idea of decentralizing business development and creating paid lead generation roles within the Cardano community is unique.


The project already has a working pilot, a live website, and a few leads validated by companies like NMKR and Socious, which shows initiative and early traction.


Integrating this system with the Andamio platform for onboarding and skill-based contribution is an interesting approach that merges education and task execution.


2. What’s a tradeoff to consider?
Central question: Is this scalable in a meaningful way? The entire deliverable hinges on producing 200 leads and training 20+ lead generators. Even at face value, this doesn’t justify $210,000 in spending.


The compensation plan (₳400–₳500 per lead, or $300–$500 USD) seems disproportionately high, particularly when many leads may not materialize into lasting value or contracts.


There’s a risk this becomes pay-for-effort rather than pay-for-outcomes, which undermines accountability and budget efficiency.


3. What’s one question you’d want to ask the proposer?
How will the project guarantee that the leads generated are high-quality and lead to actual business outcomes beyond just an introduction or a single meeting?
4. Highlight areas that are missing or require clarification
There is no clear mechanism for lead quality evaluation or ROI tracking once leads are handed over—how will the success of each lead be measured long-term?


While claiming decentralization, the platform appears centralized around the LeadGenDAO team, with limited DAO-like transparency or open governance at this stage.


There is no clear post-year sustainability model—the next steps depend on companies paying annual fees and a share of revenue, which are not guaranteed.


5. What value will it provide to your community?
For the small subset of projects that struggle with BD (business development), this may offer temporary visibility and outreach.


However, this value is narrow in scope, difficult to scale, and doesn’t clearly benefit the broader Cardano community or justify the public treasury funding.


It's also uncertain how these leads translate into long-term ecosystem value, adoption, or economic activity on-chain.

Final Notes for GovTool Comment Submission
While this proposal presents a well-structured initiative with a functioning pilot and early traction, the overall value-to-cost ratio is low. A budget of ₳300,000 (~$210K) for generating 200 leads amounts to over $1,000 per lead if we include operational overhead — a questionable investment, especially when many of these introductions may not result in meaningful engagements or value creation.
The concept of community-sourced business development is promising, but this execution lacks clear performance metrics, scalability assurances, and post-funding sustainability. There is also insufficient evidence that companies will independently adopt and pay for the service afterward.
Recommendation: No. We suggest this proposal be restructured into a smaller-scale experiment or pilot, requesting a fraction of the current funding (₳50–₳75K), with tighter success tracking and clearer KPIs for validated lead outcomes.

Hello,

Thank you very much for your constructive comment, let me answer all your questions.

This project aims to connect companies to Cardano dApps, which will bring HUGE value to the community. There is currently very few activities in the ecosystem. Most of the proposals created now are technical proposals, but how are we going to bring business value to the ecosystem ? That is what the LeadgenDao project is focusing on.

"2. What’s a tradeoff to consider?"
I understand that the rewards for the leads seems a little high, but this is the price that the companies are willing to pay to get some leads, and in the future of this project, the companies will pay these rewards themselves. Companies in general spend a lot of money for networking and getting connections, by going to conferences, traveling, and recruiting people to get qualified leads. If you wish to bring strong lead generators that will use their network to connect businesses the amount could be reasonable

You are saying that the amount might be too high, even though the outcome is not sure to bring value. The companies need to validate the leads according to the information that the lead generator provided, it is then the company choice to validate the lead or not and pursue with a call. Even if the call does not bring direct value, a connection is still made and could potentially bring value in the future. 

3. How do we guarantee the lead is good quality ?
First of all, we are making sure that the lead needs of the companies are very clear in the course, so the lead generators can search for the specific leads needed. We are also trying to focus more on the leads that come from personal connections, and not just LinkedIn research for example, because the connection is much easier, and the first layer of trust is already made. 
And again, the companies are choosing which leads they want to have calls with, if they think the leads do not fit their needs, they can choose not to pursue with the call, and the generator won't be rewarded for it.

 4. There is a clear ROI because we know how many leads were proposed and how many were approved, there is a dashboard for that, and it is very transparent. 
Anyone can become a lead generator, and any company that wants leads can register, it is then not a centralized ecosystem, and it is very transparent for everyone.

We aim to offer this project to more companies, and we will charge these companies to come onboard to the platform, the will be an annual fee + commissions.
Companies have a lot of budget to spend for that, it is quite an expensive process for them to get qualified leads and deals. We can already show incredible results with some leads from NMKR.

5. Which value to the community ?
Anyone can be a lead generator, so anyone that has a great vision on a collaboration that could work with the Cardano companies, could just upload his lead, create a great collaboration, and get rewarded for it. 

And as said in the beginning, this project could bring HUGE value to the community and ecosystem of Cardano.


I want also to add that in the Budget proposals, there are really few marketing and promotion proposals and this is one of them, which we think could be very valid for the Cardano budget for this year, most of the proposals are technical proposals.
